name: setlist-mcp
description: setlist.fm concert data for Claude — search setlists, artists, venues, tours, and cities via natural language

setlist_api_key.title: setlist.fm API Key
setlist_api_key.description: Your setlist.fm API key (apply at https://www.setlist.fm/settings/api). Required for the setlist.fm data (read) tools; the attendance tools and setlist_id_from_url work without it.

setlist_accept_language.title: Language (optional)
setlist_accept_language.description: Localize city/country names: one of en, es, fr, de, pt, tr, it, pl

setlist_session_cookie.title: Session cookie (optional)
setlist_session_cookie.description: Only for the attendance write tools: the Cookie header from a logged-in www.setlist.fm request (DevTools → Network). Leave blank to use the read-only tools.

setlist_disable_fetchproxy.title: Disable browser bridge (optional)
setlist_disable_fetchproxy.description: Set to 1 to turn the browser (fetchproxy) fallback off for the attendance tools (1/true/yes/on).

fetchproxy_ws_port.title: fetchproxy port (advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_port.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: fetchproxy bind address (advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: fetchproxy identity directory (advanced)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).

tools.name: setlist_search_artists
tools.description: Search for artists by name or MusicBrainz ID

tools.name: setlist_get_artist
tools.description: Get an artist by MusicBrainz ID

tools.name: setlist_get_artist_setlists
tools.description: Get an artist's setlists

tools.name: setlist_search_setlists
tools.description: Search setlists by artist, venue, city, date, tour, and more

tools.name: setlist_get_setlist
tools.description: Get a setlist by its ID

tools.name: setlist_get_setlist_version
tools.description: Get a specific version of a setlist

tools.name: setlist_search_venues
tools.description: Search for venues by name or location

tools.name: setlist_get_venue
tools.description: Get a venue by its ID

tools.name: setlist_get_venue_setlists
tools.description: Get setlists performed at a venue

tools.name: setlist_search_cities
tools.description: Search for cities by name or location

tools.name: setlist_get_city
tools.description: Get a city by its geoId

tools.name: setlist_search_countries
tools.description: List all supported countries

tools.name: setlist_get_user
tools.description: Get a setlist.fm user by userId

tools.name: setlist_get_user_attended
tools.description: Get the concerts a user marked as attended

tools.name: setlist_get_user_edited
tools.description: Get the setlists a user has edited

tools.name: setlist_resolve_concerts
tools.description: Batch-resolve up to 24 {artist, date, city?, venue?} to their best-match setlists

tools.name: setlist_mark_attended
tools.description: Record on your account that you attended a show (needs SETLIST_SESSION_COOKIE or a signed-in browser via fetchproxy; undo with setlist_unmark_attended)

tools.name: setlist_unmark_attended
tools.description: Remove a show from your attended list (needs SETLIST_SESSION_COOKIE or a signed-in browser via fetchproxy; undo with setlist_mark_attended)

tools.name: setlist_id_from_url
tools.description: Extract a setlist ID from a setlist.fm setlist URL (local parse, no network)

tools.name: setlist_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify the API key works against the setlist.fm API
